columns.description: Cedar Press administrative-region key, format `CEDAR-ADMREG-######`. Shared column contract with the BIA/IHS/HUD-ONAP region crosswalk. NIGC regions occupy the reserved 9000xx block. **A region id is specific to a region SYSTEM VERSION**: `Region I` under the FY2001 system and `Region I` under the FY2003 system are different geographies and carry different ids.
columns.name: administrative_region_id

columns.description: Always `NIGC_REGION`. Names the region system this row belongs to.
columns.name: region_system_code

columns.description: NIGC's name for the region as printed for that system version. Values change across versions (`Eastern Region` -> `Region VI` -> `Washington DC`); see `region_system_version`.
columns.name: region_name

columns.description: Which of NIGC's four region systems was in force. One of: `NIGC_R1_FY2001_FY2002` (6 regions), `NIGC_R2_FY2003_FY2007` (6), `NIGC_R3_FY2008_FY2016` (7), `NIGC_R4_FY2017_present` (8). **Never join across versions on `region_name` alone.**
columns.name: region_system_version

columns.description: NIGC fiscal year the revenue covers. Operations have differing fiscal year-ends, so a fiscal year is a reporting window, not a calendar window.
columns.name: fiscal_year

columns.description: Gross gaming revenue in nominal US dollars as NIGC printed it. See `figure_precision` before treating it as exact.
columns.name: ggr_usd

columns.description: `ggr_usd` in constant 2025 dollars, BEA GDP implicit price deflator (NIPA Table 1.1.9). Base year is 2025 because 2026 is not a complete year and BEA publishes no annual index for it.
columns.name: ggr_usd_real2025

columns.description: Number of gaming operations NIGC counted in the region that year. **An operation is a submitter of audited financial statements, not a building.** It is not a property count and will not reconcile 1:1 with a facility file.
columns.name: operation_count

columns.description: Percent change in `ggr_usd` against the same region's prior fiscal year within the same region system version. Blank where the prior year sits in a different system.
columns.name: ggr_change_pct

columns.description: How `ggr_change_pct` was obtained. One of: `computed_from_cedar_series_exact`, `computed_from_cedar_series_rounded_inputs` (inputs rounded to $0.1B, so the percentage carries that rounding), `no_prior_year_in_this_region_system`.
columns.name: ggr_change_pct_basis

columns.description: `ggr_usd` / `operation_count`. **A descriptive statistic about the region, never an estimate for any property.** In FY2025 roughly 9% of operations made ~56% of GGR while 54%+ made ~5%, so this mean describes almost no individual operation.
columns.name: region_mean_ggr_per_operation_usd

columns.description: Always 1. Present so that a downstream join cannot silently promote the regional mean into a property-level figure.
columns.name: region_mean_is_descriptive_only

columns.description: Always `nigc_gross_gaming_revenue`.
columns.name: revenue_measure

columns.description: Always `nigc_region`. The finest level at which this revenue exists.
columns.name: geographic_level

columns.description: Always `aggregate_only`. NIGC publishes no property-level revenue and Cedar Press does not construct one.
columns.name: allocation_level

columns.description: Always `false`.
columns.name: includes_nongaming_revenue

columns.name: figure_precision

columns.description: Which column of which report the figure came from. `own_year_report` = the report headlined for this fiscal year. `prior_year_column` = the comparison column of a later report.
